calls.statement:
WITH e AS (
  SELECT x.*, m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure x LEFT JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = x.member_key WHERE x.campaign_id = 19
)
SELECT count(*) rows_, count(DISTINCT exposure_id) ids, count(DISTINCT member_key) keys, count(DISTINCT member_id) mids,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE member_id IS NULL) nomember,
  count(DISTINCT member_id) FILTER (WHERE delivered) deliv_m,
  count(DISTINCT member_id) FILTER (WHERE member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=19)) in_holdout,
  min(contact_ts_utc) mn, max(contact_ts_utc) mx,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=19) hold_rows,
  (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=19) hold_distinct,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM stg_campaign_contact_load WHERE campaign_id=19) stg_rows,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM stg_campaign_contact_load s WHERE campaign_id=19 AND exposure_id IN (SELECT exposure_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure)) stg_overlap
FROM e

WITH c AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure x JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=x.member_key WHERE x.campaign_id=19),
s AS (SELECT f.*, m.member_id FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=f.member_key JOIN c ON c.member_id=m.member_id
      WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24')
SELECT count(*) n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) ids, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) rl, count(DISTINCT member_id) buyers,
 sum(net_amount) net, sum(gross_amount) gross, sum(net_amount) FILTER (WHERE staff_purchase_flag) staff_net, count(*) FILTER (WHERE staff_purchase_flag) staff_n,
 sum(net_amount) FILTER (WHERE channel_code='WB') web_net,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE net_amount<=0) nonpos,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE CAST(sale_ts_utc AS DATE) <> sale_date) tsdiff,
 count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) loads,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM stg_sales_line_load WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24') stg_n,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM stg_sales_line_load WHERE sales_line_id IN (SELECT sales_line_id FROM fact_sales_line)) stg_overlap
FROM s

WITH c AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure x JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=x.member_key WHERE x.campaign_id=19),
s AS (SELECT f.*, m.member_id FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=f.member_key JOIN c ON c.member_id=m.member_id
      WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24')

  min(s.etl_loaded_at) mn, max(s.etl_loaded_at) mx

WITH c AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure x JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=x.member_key WHERE x.campaign_id=19),
r AS (SELECT f.*, m.member_id FROM fact_return_line f JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=f.member_key JOIN c ON c.member_id=m.member_id
      WHERE f.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24')
SELECT count(*) n, count(DISTINCT return_line_id) ids, sum(refund_net) refund_net, sum(refund_gross) rg,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM stg_return_line_load WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24') stg_n,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM stg_return_line_load WHERE return_line_id IN (SELECT return_line_id FROM fact_return_line)) stg_ov
FROM r

SELECT 'cal' k, fiscal_period_label a, CAST(fully_loaded AS VARCHAR) b, CAST(period_start_date AS VARCHAR) c, CAST(period_end_date AS VARCHAR) d FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE period_start_date <= DATE '2026-05-24' AND period_end_date >= DATE '2026-05-04'
UNION ALL SELECT 'maxsale', CAST(max(sale_date) AS VARCHAR), CAST(count(*) AS VARCHAR), NULL, NULL FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date >= DATE '2026-05-01'
UNION ALL SELECT 'closed_days', CAST(count(*) AS VARCHAR), NULL, NULL, NULL FROM dim_date WHERE calendar_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24' AND NOT is_trading_day
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_keys', CAST(count(*) AS VARCHAR), NULL, NULL, NULL FROM (SELECT member_key FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)

calls.statement:
WITH contacted AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
  FROM fact_campaign_exposure x JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = x.member_key
  WHERE x.campaign_id = 19
),
sales AS (
  SELECT sum(f.net_amount) AS net_sales_before_returns
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key
  WHERE m.member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM contacted) AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24'
),
refunds AS (
  SELECT coalesce(sum(r.refund_net), 0) AS refunds_net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = r.member_key
  WHERE m.member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM contacted) AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24'
)
SELECT 19 AS campaign_id, 'Spring Garden Launch 2026' AS campaign_name,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM contacted) AS members_contacted,
  s.net_sales_before_returns - r.refunds_net AS net_spend_eur_ex_vat
FROM sales s, refunds r
